source_instruction: i am looking for resealable snak club antioxidant trail mix. 5.5oz packs of six.
query: You wouldn’t believe the detour I took to get to the grocery store today—there was a whole group of folks setting up for a neighborhood block party right on the main sidewalk, stringing those crinkly rainbow streamers between oak trees and hauling coolers stacked with what smelled like grilled corn slathered in chili lime. I stopped for a minute to pet the fluffiest golden retriever I’ve ever seen, who was trotting around with a tiny bandana that said “official treat taster” tied around his neck, and he even dropped a slobbery tennis ball at my feet like he was inviting me to stay for the fun. I almost bailed on my errand entirely to hang around, but I remembered I was totally out of easy grab-and-go snacks for my work breaks this week, so I waved at the party organizers and kept heading into the store. Hey, I’m looking through the dried fruits & raisins section right now and could use some help picking something out. I need it to come in a resealable bag, that’s non-negotiable for me so I don’t have to fumble with clips to keep it fresh between snacks. I’m also only looking for options that are certified USDA organic, since my roommate swears organic dried fruit tastes way better than the regular stuff. I want the price to be totally reasonable, nothing that feels like a total ripoff for what you get, and I just need the regular standard pack size they usually sell for this kind of thing, you know?
